name: Project Manager Suite
title: Project Manager Excel Suite: Portfolio, Schedule, Budget, Risks, Sprints, Team Capacity, Status Reports, Closure, 15 Languages
headline: Run every project from eight connected Excel workbooks
seo_title: Project Management Excel Templates – Schedule, Budget, Risks
seo_description: Eight Excel workbooks for project managers: portfolio, schedule, team capacity, budget, risks and changes, sprints, status reports and closure. 15 languages.
description:
Projects rarely fail in one day. They slip a little at a time: a task that started late, a team member booked on two projects, a budget line spent faster than planned, a risk nobody followed up, a change agreed in a meeting but never priced, an action from the steering meeting that no one owned. The signs are there, scattered across notes, emails and spreadsheets that never agree with each other.

This suite brings the whole job of a project manager into eight connected Excel workbooks. You enter each fact once - a task date, an hour worked, an invoice, a risk score, a decision - and every check, alert, chart and report updates itself.

What the eight workbooks cover:
1. Portfolio and project initiation: project register, business cases, charters, scope, sponsors and approvals.
2. Planning and scheduling: tasks, milestones, dependencies, baselines, holidays and schedule slippage.
3. Team, capacity and time: allocations, availability, timesheets, utilisation, skills and contractors.
4. Budget, costs and procurement: budgets by phase, actual costs, forecasts, purchase orders, vendors and client billing.
5. Risks, issues, changes and decisions: risk register with scores, issue log, change requests, assumptions, dependencies and decision log.
6. Tasks, sprints and boards: backlog, sprint plans, task board, stand-ups, blockers, velocity and retrospectives.
7. Stakeholders, meetings and reporting: stakeholder map, communication plan, meeting minutes, actions and weekly status reports.
8. Quality, delivery and closure: deliverables, test runs, acceptance, defects, handover, lessons learned and benefits.

Every workbook has a dashboard with key figures, monthly charts and breakdowns, ready tools (capacity calculator, budget forecast, risk scoring and more), printable forms and documents, checklists and ready-to-send messages. The sample data shows a delivery company with twelve projects, fourteen team members, ten clients and twelve vendors, so you can see every page working before you type your own data.

You get standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, in 15 languages: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese and Indonesian. Each language comes as a blank template and a filled sample.

faq.a: No. The files are standard xlsx files that open in Microsoft Excel and in LibreOffice Calc, which is free.

faq.q: Does it suit one project and a whole portfolio?
faq.a: Yes. It works for a single project or for many; the sample data shows twelve projects run by one delivery team, with clients, vendors and contractors.

faq.q: Does it work for agile and for plan-based projects?
faq.a: Yes. Plan-based projects use the schedule, baselines and milestones; agile teams use the backlog, sprints, task board and velocity. Many teams use both.

faq.q: Do I have to enter the same data twice?
faq.a: No. Each fact is entered once in its table, and every dashboard, alert, tool and report reads it from there.

faq.q: Can I change the lists, rates and settings?
faq.a: Yes. Team members, clients, vendors, cost categories, rates, thresholds and dates are all on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.
Fifteen: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese and Indonesian, each as a blank template and a filled sample.
